items.claim: Alexander Poppik is undersized for heavyweight, having previously fought at middleweight and light heavyweight.
items.quote: Poppik is literally like not a heavyweight. Making his heavyweight debut, he's fought, you know, at middleweight in multiple fights, light heavyweight, of course, as of recent.

items.claim: Jovon Leica will have a massive weight advantage, potentially outweighing Alexander Poppik by 40 to 50 pounds.
items.quote: Lakeish is going to be the hometown guy. He's going to be the much much much bigger fighter. I mean, this guy Leica might have, you know, 40 to maybe even 50 pounds on, you know, Poppik.

items.claim: Jovon Leica will utilize his wrestling to take the fight to the ground and finish Alexander Poppik.
items.quote: I think Lake is going to go out there and get the fight down to the ground and probably just smash this guy.
